content:
BUILT CoLAB will welcome and co-supervise three new doctoral students with scholarships awarded by FCT, intended for completion in a non-academic environment: Zannat Shangi, Hiago Alves, and Gedeandro Santos.

The applications, developed in collaboration between students and supervising entities, are based on the main competencies of the BUILT CoLAB team in the field of digital transformation and sustainability.

Work Plans to be Developed:

“Design Methodology for Climate-Adaptive Modular Housing Construction”, by Zannat Shangi

Institution awarding the degree: University of Porto.

Supervision de Bárbara Rangel (FEUP), e co-supervision de José Pinto (Krear) e Luís Sanhudo (BUILT CoLAB)

“Projetar para Produzir: Uma Abordagem Digital Integrada com BIM e BI para a Construção Industrializada”, by Hiago Alves

Institution awarding the degree: University of Porto.

Supervision de Bárbara Rangel (FEUP), e co-supervision de Diego Calvetti (FEUP), José Pinto (Krear) e Luís Sanhudo (BUILT CoLAB).

“Gestão de construção de emergência em locais remotos com impressão 3D em grande escala” , by Gedeandro Santos

Institution awarding the degree: University of Porto.

Supervision de Bárbara Rangel (FEUP), e co-supervision de Vanessa Tavares (BUILT CoLAB).

These FCT doctoral scholarships aim to fund research activities conducted by the scholarship holder leading to the award of a doctoral degree, developed in close collaboration with non-academic entities such as BUILT CoLAB. As a Collaborative Laboratory, BUILT CoLAB thus continues its mission of strengthening ties with academia and promoting its connection with the business world.

Since 2024, three other doctoral programmes have been running in a non-academic environment, hosted by BUILT CoLAB and co-supervised by Luís Sanhudo and Vanessa Tavares. Information here.
